name: github-cicd-pipeline-dashboard
description: College DevOps Project - GitHub-Based Automated CI/CD Pipeline Dashboard

scripts.start: node -e "const http=require('http'),fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const mime={'html':'text/html','css':'text/css','js':'text/javascript','svg':'image/svg+xml','json':'application/json'};const s=http.createServer((q,r)=>{let f=path.join(process.cwd(),q.url==='/'?'index.html':q.url);if(fs.existsSync(f)&&fs.statSync(f).isFile()){let ext=path.extname(f).slice(1);r.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':mime[ext]||'text/plain'});fs.createReadStream(f).pipe(r);}else{r.writeHead(404);r.end('Not Found');}});s.listen(3000,()=>console.log('Local Preview Server running at http://localhost:3000'));"

author: DevOps Student
